findings.title: Archive validation and import can use different files
findings.scenario: A concurrent process replaces the archive pathname after validation but before Docker reopens it for import.
findings.expected: Docker imports the exact archive object that passed validation.
findings.actual: Validation reads one file while Docker may reopen and import a different file at the same pathname.
findings.evidence: A focused fake-Docker barrier test replaces the archive after validation; the loader receives substituted bytes.
findings.next_action: Open once without following symlinks, validate that descriptor, and pass the same descriptor to Docker.
findings.closure_condition: The substitution test can no longer make imported bytes differ from validated bytes.
